limitations: Published surveys have no matched pre-2020 baseline
Predictive no-shock bands are extrapolations, not causal estimates

allcause_weekly.definition: CDC state of occurrence, event week; pre-2020 final and 2020-2023 provisional
allcause_weekly.title: Registered all-cause deaths

anxiety.definition: Household Pulse weighted PHQ-2/GAD-2 symptoms; 7-day reference before 2021-07-21, 14 days thereafter
anxiety.title: Anxiety or depression symptoms

covid_cases.definition: New cases by date reported to WHO; detection and reporting vary
covid_cases.title: Reported COVID cases

covid_deaths.definition: New deaths by date reported to WHO; corrections retained
covid_deaths.title: Reported COVID deaths

employment.definition: ILO modeled employment ratio, total age 15+; estimates can revise
employment.title: Employment to population

gdp.definition: World Bank NY.GDP.PCAP.KD; national accounts in constant 2015 US dollars
gdp.title: Real GDP per person

immunization.definition: WHO/UNICEF DPT coverage estimates, not direct service-use counts
immunization.title: Routine DTP immunization

life_expectancy.definition: Period life expectancy estimate; not an individual forecast
life_expectancy.title: Life expectancy at birth

mortality.definition: WDI demographic estimates, not daily registered deaths or excess mortality
mortality.title: Crude all-cause mortality

population.definition: World Bank population estimates; annual vintage
population.title: Population

school.definition: Gross secondary enrollment includes pupils outside the official age range; may exceed 100
school.title: Secondary school enrollment

school_policy.definition: OxCGRT C1M majority-population school closure policy
school_policy.title: School closure policy

stringency.definition: OxCGRT national total weighted policy index; not enforcement or adherence
stringency.title: Policy stringency

work_policy.definition: OxCGRT C2M majority-population workplace closure policy
work_policy.title: Workplace closure policy
